description: The licensed Predictions feed for one league: kind=games (our line, total, win chances and fair prices for every game), kind=props (player projections with over and under chances) or kind=markets (team totals, halves, quarters and other game markets). Needs a Predictions licence covering the league. League codes: nfl, cfb, nba, cbb, wnba, nhl, mlb, afl, nrl, epl, laliga, bundesliga, seriea, ligue1, mls, eflchamp, brasileirao, aleague, worldcup, tennis, ufc, cricket.

league.description: League code, for example nfl, nba, epl.

team.description: Optional: only rows whose teams (or player's team or name) contain this text.
